response.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) as avg_quantity, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) as relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_avg_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT is.invoice_number, is.avg_quantity, is.relative_gap, is.avg_quantity - oa.overall_avg_quantity as qty_above_overall_avg FROM invoice_stats is CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE is.avg_quantity > oa.overall_avg_quantity ORDER BY is.avg_quantity - oa.overall_avg_quantity DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
